snippet.title: [AION 2] Road to Global Launch
snippet.description:
AION 2 takes flight October 5th. Prepare to witness the next-generation MMORPG built in Unreal Engine 5.

Step behind the scenes and hear directly from the AION 2 team bringing the world of Atreia to life. Learn more about what AION 2 has in store for players around the world.

Wishlist AION 2 Launch Scale Test now. Join September 17-18.
🪽https://s.g.nc.com/s/yPhCm

Wishlist AION 2 on Steam now. Take Flight October 5th.
🪽https://s.g.nc.com/s/TNe3p

AION 2 features a massive world built for thousands of players, with true exploration across land, sea and air, extensive character customization collectible pets, and robust PVP and PVE experiences that shape how you play.

Follow Us for the Latest #AION2 News
🪽Website: https://aion2.plaync.com/en-us/conts/teaser
🪽Discord: https://discord.gg/aion2official
🪽X: https://www.twitter.com/aion2official
🪽Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/aion2official
🪽TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@aion2official
🪽Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/aion2official
🪽Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/aion2official
